method: Visually inspected every rendered page in seven four-page contact sheets, with full-size individual inspection of pages 5, 7-11, 14-15, 18-28, covering commutative diagrams, long proofs, dense displays, theorem/proof ending and bibliography. No visible clipping, missing glyphs, unresolved references or illegible text. All-page PDF text-span bounds and suspicious-token checks supplement visual review. Existing compile log has two underfull-box notices, with no visible readability defect.
scope: Presentation only; no mathematical review, repair or correctness certification. No compilation, source edits, export or publication.
